captions.detailed: This 3D model represents a two-piece curved watchband designed to form a circular shape around a wrist. Each of the two semi-circular band segments features integrated cylindrical end-pieces designed to hold spring bars or pins for attaching to a watch head. The ends of the bands also feature interlocking cylindrical latching mechanisms, including a slotted hollow tube on one side and a solid pin-like cylinder on the other to securely snap the two halves together.
captions.instruction: Design a parametric, 3D-printable watchband in OpenSCAD consisting of two curved halves with integrated pin attachments and an interlocking clasp mechanism. Provide parameters to adjust the strap width, the overall band length (wrist size), and the pin radius for the watch lugs.
captions.factory: The code constructs the watchband using a union of two main modules: 'pins' and 'band'. The 'band' module creates the curved strap geometry by differencing two scaled cylinder/hull combinations ('outband' and a slightly smaller scaled version) to form a thin curved shell, which is then split into two halves using a large subtractive cube. Integrated latch mechanisms are added at the ends of the bands, constructed from cylinders and subtractive cubes to form open-slotted cylindrical hooks and matching solid latching pins.
